productArea.name: Milestones
productArea.scope: Search, filter, sort, create, edit, open, and close milestones across global, organization, and repository lists, including due dates, detail lists, and issue or pull request assignment. Editing the assigned issues and pull requests is outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Milestones in the global navigation and use its search, filters, and sorting.
Choose Issues then Milestones to open or create a milestone and inspect its due date, state, and assigned items.
Choose an organization and open its Milestones dashboard and team filters. Create a disposable organization if needed.
